imprint.p: This website is a demonstration project, a portfolio sample for beauty studios. It does not represent a real business.
No services are offered and no appointments are accepted. Nothing you enter on this site is saved or sent, and no button here leads to a real studio.
The studio name, texts, prices, region and all photographs are placeholders. The photographs are AI-generated.
The provider of this demonstration is named in the Impressum of the portfolio website that presents it.

privacy.p: This demonstration collects no personal data.
The booking form works only in your browser. Nothing is stored and nothing is transmitted. The last step would open a WhatsApp message, and in this demonstration no number is connected.
There is no analytics, no advertising and no external service. Fonts and images are delivered from this server.

When you open the page, the hosting provider processes technical access data such as IP address, time and requested page to deliver and secure the site. This is based on a legitimate interest in safe operation (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
A small note in the session storage remembers that the opening animation was shown. It contains no personal data and disappears when you close the tab.
For questions about data protection, see the Impressum of the portfolio website.
